# Comparison Tools

Compare products and find healthier alternatives.

## compareProducts

**Compare products** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Compare 2-5 products side by side (Nutri-Score, Green-Score, NOVA and key nutrients per 100 g) and pick the healthier option.

::: tip MCP Apps
Hosts that support MCP Apps render this result as an interactive card.
:::

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcodes` | string[] | Yes | 2-5 product barcodes (2–5 items) |

### Output

- `products`: object[]
- `missing`: string[]
- `winner` (optional): object
- `summary`: string
- `keyNutrients`: object[]

### Example

```json
// compareProducts({"barcodes":["3017620422003","7622210449283"]})
{
  "products": [
    {
      "barcode": "3017620422003",
      "name": "Nutella",
      "brand": "Nutella, Ferrero",
      "greenScore": "F",
      "novaGroup": 3
    },
    {
      "barcode": "7622210449283",
      "name": "Prince",
      "brand": "Mondelez Schweiz GmbH",
      "nutriScore": "E",
      "greenScore": "E",
      "novaGroup": 4
    }
  ],
  "missing": [],
  "winner": {
    "barcode": "7622210449283",
    "reason": "Per 100 g: fewer calories, less saturated fat, less sugar, more fiber"
  },
  "summary": "Comparison of Nutella vs Prince: Prince is the healthier choice. Per 100 g: fewer calories, less saturated fat, less sugar, more fiber.",
  "keyNutrients": [
    {
      "id": "energy_kcal",
      "name": "Energy",
      "unit": "kcal",
      "values": {
        "3017620422003": 539,
        "7622210449283": 467
      },
      "better": "7622210449283"
    },
    {
      "id": "fat",
      "name": "Fat",
      "unit": "g",
      "values": {
        "3017620422003": 30.9,
        "7622210449283": 17
      },
      "better": "7622210449283"
    },
    "… 5 more"
  ]
}
```

## findHealthierAlternative

**Find healthier alternative** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Find a healthier alternative to a product (better Nutri-Score, less processed, less salt/sugar/saturated fat, more fiber/protein). Pass candidate barcodes, or omit them to search the product's own category.

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Barcode of the original product |
| `alternativeBarcodes` | string[] | No | Candidate barcodes; omit to search the same category (1–10 items) |

### Output

- `original`: object
- `found`: boolean
- `alternative` (optional): object
- `improvements`: string[]
- `candidatesConsidered`: number
- `searchedCategory` (optional): string
- `message`: string

### Example

```json
// findHealthierAlternative({"barcode":"3017620422003","alternativeBarcodes":["7622210449283"]})
{
  "original": {
    "barcode": "3017620422003",
    "name": "Nutella",
    "brand": "Nutella, Ferrero",
    "greenScore": "F",
    "novaGroup": 3
  },
  "found": true,
  "alternative": {
    "barcode": "7622210449283",
    "name": "Prince",
    "brand": "Mondelez Schweiz GmbH",
    "nutriScore": "E",
    "greenScore": "E",
    "novaGroup": 4
  },
  "improvements": [
    "Less saturated fat: 5.6 vs 10.6 per 100 g",
    "Less sugar: 32.0 vs 56.3 per 100 g",
    "… 1 more"
  ],
  "candidatesConsidered": 1,
  "message": "Prince is a healthier alternative to Nutella"
}
```

## compareNutrientDensity

**Compare nutrient density** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Rank products by nutrient density (% Daily Value of beneficial nutrients per 100 kcal).

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcodes` | string[] | Yes | Product barcodes (2–10 items) |

### Output

- `ranking`: object[]
- `mostNutrientDense`: string
- `missing`: string[]

### Example

```json
// compareNutrientDensity({"barcodes":["3017620422003","7622210449283"]})
{
  "ranking": [
    {
      "barcode": "7622210449283",
      "name": "Prince",
      "density": 6
    },
    {
      "barcode": "3017620422003",
      "name": "Nutella",
      "density": 2
    }
  ],
  "mostNutrientDense": "7622210449283",
  "missing": []
}
```

## rankByNutrient

**Rank by nutrient** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Rank products by one nutrient per 100 g (e.g. highest protein, lowest sugars). Products without data go last.

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcodes` | string[] | Yes | Product barcodes (2–10 items) |
| `nutrient` | string | Yes | Nutrient id, e.g. protein, fiber, sugars, salt, sodium, saturated_fat, energy_kcal |
| `ascending` | boolean | No | true = lowest first, false = highest first (default `true`) |

### Output

- `nutrient`: string
- `sortOrder`: string
- `ranking`: object[]
- `missing`: string[]

### Example

```json
// rankByNutrient({"barcodes":["3017620422003","7622210449283"],"nutrient":"sugars"})
{
  "nutrient": "sugars",
  "sortOrder": "lowest first",
  "ranking": [
    {
      "barcode": "7622210449283",
      "name": "Prince",
      "value": 32,
      "unit": "g"
    },
    {
      "barcode": "3017620422003",
      "name": "Nutella",
      "value": 56.3,
      "unit": "g"
    }
  ],
  "missing": []
}
```
